title: VIRTUAL SINGER Chapter1 Episode17 Endings and Beginnings

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: *Sigh*...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I was really looking forward to putting on a show with everyone, but they went home! This is no fun!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
It's unfortunate, but that's just the way it is.
Even Tsukasa looked a bit surprised when he arrived.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Emu sure seemed to be enjoying herself, though.

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: Miku! Cheer up!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I know. How about I put on a show of my own to cheer you up, Miku?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: A show of your own?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yeah. Check it out.
From this hat... Voila!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wh-Whoa! A whole deck of cards just came flying out☆

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: Wow!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Now, I just wave my magic wand, and...

rows.Speaker: Bunny Plushie
rows.Line: It turned into a bouquet of flowers!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wow! A magic show! Can I try it too?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Of course. How about we practice together?
Here, hold the wand like this, then...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Ta-da! A bouquet of flowers♪

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: Wow! That's amazing!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Great job, Miku! You only just started practicing and you already look like a full-fledged magician.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehehe☆ How did you enjoy Miku the Magician's Magic Show, everyone?

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: It was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wonderful!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hm? What's the matter, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Every show, no matter how fun, has to end eventually.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It makes me happy to practice hard and see everyone's smiling faces, but it's always a little sad when the show ends.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Miku...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That's true. Every show must eventually come to an end.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But without an ending, there can be no beginning.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Without an ending, there can be no beginning?

rows.Speaker: Bunny Plushie
rows.Line: Is that a riddle?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Without an ending, there can be no beginning...
I don't get it! What does that mean?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: If a show never ends, you'd never be able to experience the anticipation for the next one to begin.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The anticipation?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes. Every show eventually comes to an end, but as long as the audience is looking forward to the next fun show, we can continue performing.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So let's put on another show which everyone will want to come see again.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You mean if we put on a show everyone wants to see, then we'll be able to do even more?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That's right. As many as you like.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Then I'm going to work even harder to put on a show that everyone will want to see again and again☆

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That way everyone else and I can have fun performing forever!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That's the spirit! I'll make sure to work just as hard to make each show even better than the last!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I want to see a smile on everyone's face!
I'll make sure you never stop smiling either, KAITO♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: How about we have a little contest to see who can make more people smile, then?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That sounds fun! I'm going to win, of course!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha! Don't be so sure about that!
